name: Wazuh Daily Healthcheck PDF over Email

parameters.command:
f=$(mktemp)
cat > "$f" <<'WZ_EOF'
export LC_ALL=C
export PATH="$PATH:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/share/filebeat/bin"
S=""
if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] && sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then S="sudo -n"; fi
k() { printf 'K|%s|%s\n' "$1" "$2"; }
bs() { printf 'B|%s\n' "$1"; }
be() { printf 'E|%s\n' "$1"; }
has_unit() { systemctl list-unit-files "$1.service" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^$1.service"; }
P=0
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || [ -n "$S" ]; then P=1; fi

# ---------------- system ----------------
k HOST "$(hostname)"
k USER "$(id -un)"
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then k PRIV root; elif [ -n "$S" ]; then k PRIV sudo; else k PRIV none; fi
k OS "$(. /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null; echo "$PRETTY_NAME")"
k UPTIME "$(uptime -p 2>/dev/null)"
k LOAD "$(cut -d' ' -f1-3 /proc/loadavg)"
k CPUS "$(nproc)"
k MEM_MB "$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/{print $2"|"$3"|"$7}')"
k SWAP_MB "$(free -m | awk '/^Swap:/{print $2"|"$3}')"
k NTP "$(timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized --value 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
k MAXMAP "$(sysctl -n vm.max_map_count 2>/dev/null)"
k FAILED_UNITS "$(systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | paste -sd, -)"
k OOM24 "$($S journalctl -k --since '24 hours ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -ciE 'out of memory|oom-kill|killed process')"
bs DF
df -P -k -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x squashfs -x overlay 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | awk '{print $6"|"$5"|"$4"|"$2}'
be DF
bs DFI
df -P -i -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x squashfs -x overlay 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | awk '{print $6"|"$5}'
be DFI
bs PORTS
ss -H -lntu 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1"|"$5}'
be PORTS

# ---------------- services ----------------
for s in wazuh-manager wazuh-indexer wazuh-dashboard filebeat; do
  if has_unit "$s"; then
    ts=$(systemctl show -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value "$s" 2>/dev/null)
    ep=$(date -d "$ts" +%s 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$ep" ]; then up=$(( $(date +%s) - ep )); else up=-1; fi
    printf 'SVC|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s\n' "$s" "$(systemctl is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null)" "$(systemctl is-enabled "$s" 2>/dev/null)" "$up" "$(systemctl show -p NRestarts --value "$s" 2>/dev/null)"
  fi
done

# ---------------- certificates ----------------
bs CERTS
if [ "$P" = 1 ]; then
for f in $($S find /etc/wazuh-indexer/certs /etc/wazuh-dashboard/certs /etc/filebeat/certs -maxdepth 1 -name '*.pem' ! -name '*key*' 2>/dev/null); do
  e=$($S openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in "$f" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2)
  [ -z "$e" ] && continue
  ee=$(date -d "$e" +%s 2>/dev/null)
  [ -z "$ee" ] && continue
  echo "$f|$e|$(( (ee - $(date +%s)) / 86400 ))"
done
fi
be CERTS

# ---------------- disk consumers ----------------
if [ "$P" = 1 ]; then
  bs DU
  for d in /var/lib/wazuh-indexer /var/ossec/logs/archives /var/ossec/logs/alerts /var/ossec/queue /var/ossec/backup /var/log /var/lib/docker /home /opt /root /tmp; do
    if [ -e "$d" ]; then echo "$d|$($S du -sxm "$d" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"; fi
  done
  be DU
fi

# ---------------- wazuh manager ----------------
if has_unit wazuh-manager || [ -d /var/ossec ]; then
  k MGR_PRESENT 1
  if [ "$P" = 1 ]; then
  k MGR_VERSION "$($S /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-control info 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^WAZUH_VERSION="\(.*\)"/\1/p')"
  bs MGR_STATUS
  $S /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-control status 2>&1
  be MGR_STATUS
  out=$($S timeout 60 /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t 2>&1); rc=$?
  bs CONFTEST
  echo "$out" | tail -15 | cut -c1-240
  be CONFTEST
  k CONFTEST_RC "$rc"
  bs AGENTS
  $S /var/ossec/bin/agent_control -l 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^ *ID:'
  be AGENTS
  for f in analysisd remoted; do
    bs STATE_$f
    $S cat /var/ossec/var/run/wazuh-$f.state 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^[a-z_0-9]+="
    be STATE_$f
  done
  L=/var/ossec/logs/ossec.log
  k LOG_ERR "$($S grep -c ' ERROR: ' $L 2>/dev/null)"
  k LOG_CRIT "$($S grep -c ' CRITICAL: ' $L 2>/dev/null)"
  bs LOG_LAST
  $S grep -E ' (ERROR|CRITICAL): ' $L 2>/dev/null | tail -8 | cut -c1-260
  be LOG_LAST
  A=/var/ossec/logs/alerts/alerts.json
  if $S test -f "$A"; then
    m=$($S stat -c %Y "$A" 2>/dev/null)
    [ -n "$m" ] && k ALERTS_JSON_AGE "$(( $(date +%s) - m ))"
  fi
  AR=/var/ossec/logs/archives/archives.json
  if $S test -f "$AR"; then
    m=$($S stat -c %Y "$AR" 2>/dev/null)
    [ -n "$m" ] && k ARCHIVES_FILE_AGE "$(( $(date +%s) - m ))"
    line=$($S tail -n 1 "$AR" 2>/dev/null)
    k ARCHIVES_LAST_TS "$(echo "$line" | grep -o '"timestamp":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)"
    k ARCHIVES_LAST_AGENT "$(echo "$line" | grep -o '"agent":{[^}]*}' | head -1 | grep -o '"name":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)"
    k ARCHIVES_LAST_LOC "$(echo "$line" | grep -o '"location":"[^"]*"' | tail -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)"
  else
    k ARCHIVES_PRESENT 0
  fi
  k LOGS_MB "$($S du -sm /var/ossec/logs 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
  k ARCHIVES_MB "$($S du -sm /var/ossec/logs/archives 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
  k ESTAB_1514 "$(ss -Htn state established '( sport = :1514 )' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
  fi
fi

# ---------------- filebeat ----------------
if has_unit filebeat && [ "$P" = 1 ]; then
  out=$($S timeout 25 filebeat test output 2>&1); rc=$?
  bs FILEBEAT_TEST
  echo "$out" | tail -15 | cut -c1-220
  be FILEBEAT_TEST
  k FILEBEAT_TEST_RC "$rc"
  k FILEBEAT_ERR24 "$($S journalctl -u filebeat --since '24 hours ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '"log.level":"error"| ERROR ')"
  bs FILEBEAT_LAST
  $S journalctl -u filebeat --since '24 hours ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"log.level":"error"| ERROR ' | tail -4 | cut -c1-260
  be FILEBEAT_LAST
fi

# ---------------- wazuh indexer ----------------
if [ -d /etc/wazuh-indexer ]; then
  k IDX_PRESENT 1
  if [ "$P" = 1 ]; then
  CERT=/etc/wazuh-indexer/certs
  IH=$($S grep -E '^network.host' /etc/wazuh-indexer/opensearch.yml 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed -E "s/^network.host: *//; s/[\"' ]//g")
  if [ -z "$IH" ] || [ "$IH" = "0.0.0.0" ]; then
    IH=$(ss -H -lnt 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 ~ /:9200$/ {print $4; exit}' | sed -E 's/:9200$//; s/^\[//; s/\]$//; s/^::ffff://')
  fi
  case "$IH" in ""|"0.0.0.0"|"*"|"::") IH=127.0.0.1;; esac
  U="https://$IH:9200"
  k IDX_URL "$U"
  q() { $S curl -sk -m 25 --cert $CERT/admin.pem --key $CERT/admin-key.pem "$@"; }
  J='Content-Type: application/json'
  k IDX_HTTP "$(q -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$U/")"
  bs IDX_HEALTH
  q "$U/_cluster/health"; echo
  be IDX_HEALTH
  bs IDX_NODES
  q "$U/_nodes/stats/fs,jvm,os,thread_pool?filter_path=nodes.*.name,nodes.*.fs.total,nodes.*.jvm.mem.heap_used_percent,nodes.*.os.cpu.percent,nodes.*.os.mem.used_percent,nodes.*.thread_pool.write.rejected,nodes.*.thread_pool.search.rejected"; echo
  be IDX_NODES
  bs IDX_UNASSIGNED
  q "$U/_cat/shards?h=index,shard,prirep,state,unassigned.reason" | grep -i unassigned | head -10
  be IDX_UNASSIGNED
  bs IDX_BLOCKS
  q "$U/wazuh-*/_settings/index.blocks.*?flat_settings=true"; echo
  be IDX_BLOCKS
  bs IDX_INDICES
  q "$U/_cat/indices/wazuh-alerts-*?h=index,store.size&bytes=b" | awk '{s+=$2;n++; if(min==""||$1<min)min=$1; if($1>max)max=$1} END{print n"|"min"|"max"|"s}'
  be IDX_INDICES
  bs IDX_TOP
  q "$U/_cat/indices?h=index,store.size,docs.count&bytes=b&s=store.size:desc" | head -8
  be IDX_TOP
  bs IDX_ARCH_LATEST
  q -XPOST -H "$J" "$U/wazuh-archives-*/_search?ignore_unavailable=true&allow_no_indices=true" -d '{"size":1,"sort":[{"timestamp":{"order":"desc"}}],"_source":["timestamp"]}'; echo
  be IDX_ARCH_LATEST
  bs IDX_COUNT24
  q -XPOST -H "$J" "$U/wazuh-alerts-*/_count" -d '{"query":{"range":{"timestamp":{"gte":"now-24h"}}}}'; echo
  be IDX_COUNT24
  bs IDX_COUNTPREV
  q -XPOST -H "$J" "$U/wazuh-alerts-*/_count" -d '{"query":{"range":{"timestamp":{"gte":"now-48h","lt":"now-24h"}}}}'; echo
  be IDX_COUNTPREV
  NOW=$(( $(date +%s) * 1000 ))
  BODY=$(cat <<JSONEND
{"size":0,"query":{"range":{"timestamp":{"gte":"now-24h"}}},"aggs":{"per_hour":{"date_histogram":{"field":"timestamp","fixed_interval":"1h","min_doc_count":0,"extended_bounds":{"min":$((NOW-86400000)),"max":$NOW}}},"top_rules":{"terms":{"field":"rule.id","size":5},"aggs":{"d":{"top_hits":{"size":1,"_source":["rule.description"]}}}},"top_agents":{"terms":{"field":"agent.name","size":5}},"high_sev":{"filter":{"range":{"rule.level":{"gte":12}}}}}}
JSONEND
)
  bs IDX_STATS
  q -XPOST -H "$J" "$U/wazuh-alerts-*/_search" -d "$BODY"; echo
  be IDX_STATS
  bs IDX_LATEST
  q -XPOST -H "$J" "$U/wazuh-alerts-*/_search" -d '{"size":1,"sort":[{"timestamp":{"order":"desc"}}],"_source":["timestamp"]}'; echo
  be IDX_LATEST
  k JVM_OPTS "$($S grep -hE '^-Xm[sx]' /etc/wazuh-indexer/jvm.options /etc/wazuh-indexer/jvm.options.d/* 2>/dev/null | paste -sd, -)"
  IL=/var/log/wazuh-indexer/wazuh-cluster.log
  k IDX_OOM "$($S grep -c 'OutOfMemoryError' $IL 2>/dev/null)"
  k IDX_LOG_ERR "$($S grep -c "^\[$(date +%Y-%m-%d)T.*\]\[ERROR" $IL 2>/dev/null)"
  bs IDX_LOG_LAST
  $S grep -E "^\[$(date +%Y-%m-%d)T.*\]\[ERROR" $IL 2>/dev/null | tail -4 | cut -c1-260
  be IDX_LOG_LAST
  fi
fi

# ---------------- wazuh dashboard ----------------
if [ -d /etc/wazuh-dashboard ]; then
  DY=/etc/wazuh-dashboard/opensearch_dashboards.yml
  DP=$($S grep -E '^server.port' $DY 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*: *//; s/[" ]//g')
  DH=$($S grep -E '^server.host' $DY 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed -E "s/.*: *//; s/[\"' ]//g")
  if [ -z "$DP" ]; then DP=443; fi
  if [ -z "$DH" ] || [ "$DH" = "0.0.0.0" ]; then DH=127.0.0.1; fi
  k DASH_PORT "$DP"
  c=$(curl -sk -m 15 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://$DH:$DP/app/login" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$c" = "000" ]; then c=$(curl -s -m 15 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://$DH:$DP/app/login" 2>/dev/null); fi
  k DASH_HTTP "$c"
  k DASH_ERR24 "$($S journalctl -u wazuh-dashboard --since '24 hours ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -ciE '\berror\b')"
  bs DASH_LAST
  $S journalctl -u wazuh-dashboard --since '24 hours ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '\berror\b' | tail -4 | cut -c1-260
  be DASH_LAST
fi
k DONE 1
WZ_EOF
bash "$f" </dev/null
rm -f "$f"

    be STATE_$f
  done
  L=/var/ossec/logs/ossec.log
  k LOG_ERR "$($S grep -c ' ERROR: ' $L 2>/dev/null)"
  k LOG_CRIT "$($S grep -c ' CRITICAL: ' $L 2>/dev/null)"
  bs LOG_LAST

  be LOG_LAST

    k ARCHIVES_LAST_LOC "$(echo "$line" | grep -o '"location":"[^"]*"' | tail -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)"

  fi

  k ARCHIVES_MB "$($S du -sm /var/ossec/logs/archives 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"

  if [ "$P" = 1 ]; then

  fi
  case "$IH" in ""|"0.0.0.0"|"*"|"::") IH=127.0.0.1;; esac

  q() { $S curl -sk -m 25 --cert $CERT/admin.pem --key $CERT/admin-key.pem "$@"; }
  J='Content-Type: application/json'
  k IDX_HTTP "$(q -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$U/")"
  bs IDX_HEALTH
  q "$U/_cluster/health"; echo
  be IDX_HEALTH
  bs IDX_NODES
  q "$U/_nodes/stats/fs,jvm,os,thread_pool?filter_path=nodes.*.name,nodes.*.fs.total,nodes.*.jvm.mem.heap_used_percent,nodes.*.os.cpu.percent,nodes.*.os.mem.used_percent,nodes.*.thread_pool.write.rejected,nodes.*.thread_pool.search.rejected"; echo

  be IDX_UNASSIGNED
  bs IDX_BLOCKS

  be IDX_BLOCKS

{"size":0,"query":{"range":{"timestamp":{"gte":"now-24h"}}},"aggs":{"per_hour":{"date_histogram":{"field":"timestamp","fixed_interval":"1h","min_doc_count":0,"extended_bounds":{"min":$((NOW-86400000)),"max":$NOW}}},"top_rules":{"terms":{"field":"rule.id","size":5},"aggs":{"d":{"top_hits":{"size":1,"_source":["rule.description"]}}}},"top_agents":{"terms":{"field":"agent.name","size":5}},"high_sev":{"filter":{"range":{"rule.level":{"gte":12}}}}}}
JSONEND
)
  bs IDX_STATS

  be IDX_STATS

  q -XPOST -H "$J" "$U/wazuh-alerts-*/_search" -d '{"size":1,"sort":[{"timestamp":{"order":"desc"}}],"_source":["timestamp"]}'; echo

  IL=/var/log/wazuh-indexer/wazuh-cluster.log
  k IDX_OOM "$($S grep -c 'OutOfMemoryError' $IL 2>/dev/null)"
